# Draft:Vanessa Warwick

Vanessa Warwick is a former MTV presenter, notable for her eight-year spell as a video jockey from 1990 to 1997  for MTVs Headbangers Ball. She was for a time during the 1990s married to musician Ricky Warwick, lead singer and guitarist with The Almighty. Vanessa Warwick now runs a London-based property business.
Born Vanessa Young, she first joined MTV in 1988 initially on a temporary assignment at the broadcaster's Camden studios in London before becoming a production assistant on the MTV rock show, "Metal Hammer" and then "Headbangers Ball", where she became the show's assistant producer.
Vanessa is also the co-founder of the UK's No.1 Landlord Community and has built as successful business with her husband Nick Tadd.  Property Tribes was founded in February 2009.  The platform is owned solely by Nick as the Director and major shareholder.
On 31st October 2024 Vanessa launched a new music TV Channel "Trust In Rock".  The show has been described as MTV's "Headbangers Ball" 2.0 on steroids.  The show celebrates heavy metal music with Vanessa back interviewing rock stars from across the globe, old and new, discovering new music along the way, reminiscing on old memories and bringing you the latest in rock news.
The show is filmed between Vanessa's home studio and on location at the iconic Karma Sanctum Hotel in the heart of London's Soho.  The first series to broadcast on the Trust In Rock channel is "RockDrop" featuring interviews, competitions, news, reviews and latest drops in the global rock music scene.
The series is being produced by Vanessa's long-time friend and ex-MTV Producer Sara Harding, the UK's leading music TV Producer having worked with MTV, Kerrang!, Scuzz TV, Sky Arts, Channel 4, AXS TV and 4Music.
